title: Introducing the New Document Builder Experience
summary: Document Builder now offers a more complete page-aware editing experience, bringing the canvas and exported PDF closer together. New page-format controls, visual navigation, page-aware tables, pagination warnings, and improved PDF rendering
body_markdown:
Document Builder now offers a more complete page-aware editing experience, bringing the canvas and exported PDF closer together. New page-format controls, visual navigation, page-aware tables, pagination warnings, and improved PDF rendering make it easier to create polished multi-page documents.


### What’s new


-


**True paginated editing:** Documents are displayed as distinct pages, with automatic and manual page breaks reflected in PDF exports.


-


**Page format controls:** Users can select supported paper sizes and switch between portrait and landscape orientation. Integrators can configure defaults, restrict available options, or hide the controls.


-


**Visual page minimap:** Multi-page documents include a collapsible thumbnail navigator for quickly reviewing and jumping between pages.


-


**Improved headers and footers:** Headers and footers are represented across pages on the canvas and repeated correctly in exported PDFs.


-


**Page-aware tables:** Tables can split across pages while optionally repeating their headers and footers on each page.


-


**Pagination warnings:** The editor identifies oversized content, overflowing headers or footers, and consecutive page breaks that could cause PDF rendering issues.


-


**Better PDF preview and export:** PDF output follows the editor’s pagination more accurately, and users can download the PDF directly from the document preview.


-


**Export-time format overrides:** Supported integrations can generate a PDF in a different paper size or orientation without modifying the saved design.


> Feature availability may vary by plan.
